Moon...

August 26, 2005

this world is an asylum
and i am the loon
with flawless stars shining
i am the spotted moon.

i may be one of my kind
huddled in sky so dark and blue
waiting to eternity for that smile
but my dreams never come true!!

hate u life… such a bitch u are…
